name: RenterSmartHome
tagline: Smart home upgrades that never cost you your deposit.
description: Renter-friendly smart home guides: no-drill smart locks, thermostats, cameras, lighting and plugs that install in minutes and leave with you when you move.

translations.note: Owner rule 2026-10-20: localized, not translated. Only posts in `categories` get de/es/nl versions, each after localizer-agent (data/briefs/<lang>/<slug>.local.json). The plain-translation backlog is stopped (backlogPerDay 0); relocalizePerDay live translations per day are re-done from a local brief (routine.mjs localize-queue).

authors.name: RenterSmartHome Editorial Team
authors.bio: We research smart home gear specifically for apartments and rentals: how it installs, whether it is reversible, what it needs from your landlord, and whether it moves with you. Every guide follows our published research process and editorial policy.
